en: n. the organ inside the body where food goes after being swallowed; the front part of the body below the chest; a desire to eat or to do something; vt. to be able to accept or tolerate something unpleasant
ex: I have a pain in my stomach after eating too much.
我吃太多後胃很痛。

en: n. a seat with legs but no back or arms, usually for one person; a piece of solid waste from the body; vi. (of a plant) to send up new shoots
ex: He sat on a wooden stool in the corner of the kitchen.
他坐在廚房角落的一張木凳上。

en: a. with strong winds, heavy rain or storms; involving a lot of angry argument or strong emotion
ex: We stayed indoors because of the stormy weather.
因為暴風雨的天氣，我們待在室內。

en: n. a device for cooking or heating, using gas, electricity or wood; vt. to break or smash a hole in something (past tense of stave)
ex: She put a pot of soup on the stove.
她在爐子上放了一鍋湯。

en: n. the dried stems of crops such as wheat, used for animal bedding or making hats and baskets; a thin tube used for drinking; a. made of straw or very unimportant
ex: Please use a paper straw instead of a plastic one.
請用紙吸管，不要用塑膠的。

en: n. the way in which the parts of something are arranged or organized; a building or other large object that has been built; vt. to arrange or organize something in a clear system
ex: The structure of the essay was clear and logical.
這篇文章的結構清楚而有邏輯。

en: a. unwilling to change your opinion or behavior even when other people try to persuade you; difficult to get rid of or deal with
ex: My grandfather is so stubborn that he refuses to wear a hearing aid.
我爺爺很固執，不肯戴助聽器。

en: n. a particular type of solid, liquid or gas; the most important or main point of something; real importance or meaning; wealth
ex: The report lacks substance and offers few new ideas.
這份報告缺乏實質內容，也沒什麼新想法。

en: vt. to take one number or amount away from another; to take something away from a total; vi. to do subtraction
ex: If you subtract five from ten, you get five.
十減五等於五。

en: vt. to pull liquid or air into the mouth using the lips and tongue; to hold something in the mouth and use the tongue on it; vi. to draw liquid in; n. an act of sucking
ex: The baby sucked on a bottle of milk.
嬰兒吮吸著一瓶牛奶。

en: vt. to experience something painful or unpleasant; to be affected by something bad; vi. to feel pain or become damaged
ex: Many people suffer from headaches during the winter.
許多人在冬天會頭痛。

en: n. the act of killing oneself intentionally; a person who has killed themselves; v. to kill oneself intentionally; a. extremely dangerous or likely to cause one's own destruction
ex: The hotline helps people who are thinking about suicide.
這條專線協助有輕生念頭的人。

en: n. a short statement that gives the main points of something; a. done quickly without a formal process or detailed attention
ex: Please write a short summary of the article.
請為這篇文章寫一份簡短的摘要。

en: n. the highest point of a mountain; the highest level of achievement or power; an important meeting between the leaders of countries; a. involving the leaders of governments
ex: They reached the summit of the mountain at sunrise.
他們在日出時抵達了山頂。

en: n. a set of questions asked to many people to find out their opinions; a careful look at something; the measuring of land; vt. to ask people questions to find out about their opinions; to look carefully at something; vi. to measure an area of land
ex: A recent survey shows that most people prefer online shopping.
最近的一項調查顯示，大多數人偏好網路購物。

en: n. a person who continues to live after an accident, disaster or illness that killed others; someone who has managed to live through a difficult situation
ex: There were no survivors from the plane crash.
那場空難沒有倖存者。

en: v. to think that something is probably true or likely to be present; to believe someone is guilty without proof; n. a person who is thought to have committed a crime; a. not able to be trusted
ex: The police arrested a suspect in connection with the robbery.
警方逮捕了一名與搶案有關的嫌疑犯。

en: n. a feeling that someone has done something wrong; a feeling that something is true without proof; a very small amount of something
ex: She looked at him with suspicion.
她帶著懷疑的眼神看著他。

en: n. a large white water bird with a long, curved neck; a person with great talent; vi. (informal) to move around with no purpose
ex: A graceful swan glided across the lake.
一隻優雅的天鵝滑過湖面。

en: vt. to make a serious promise; to use rude or offensive words; to make someone take an oath; vi. to say words that are rude or offensive; n. an act of cursing
ex: He swore to tell the truth in court.
他發誓在法庭上說實話。

en: n. salty liquid that comes out of the skin when you are hot or nervous; a worried or anxious state; vi. to produce sweat; to worry or work hard
ex: Sweat ran down his face after the long run.
長跑後汗水從他臉上滑下。

en: vi. to become larger or rounder than normal; to grow stronger in feeling or sound; vt. to cause to expand; n. a long wave on the sea; a. (informal) excellent
ex: Her ankle began to swell after she twisted it.
她扭傷腳踝後，腳開始腫起來。

en: n. a weapon with a long metal blade and a handle; a symbol of military power; a long narrow shape
ex: The knight drew his sword and charged forward.
騎士拔出劍向前衝去。

en: n. a person whose job is to make clothes that fit individual customers; vt. to make or change something to suit a particular person or need; vi. to work as a tailor
ex: The tailor measured him for a new suit.
裁縫師為他量身訂做一套新西裝。

en: n. a natural ability to do something well; a person who has a natural ability; (in ancient times) a unit of money
ex: She has a talent for music and has played the piano since she was four.
她有音樂天分，四歲就開始彈鋼琴。

en: a. liking to talk a lot; tending to chatter
ex: My neighbor is very talkative and always wants to chat.
我的鄰居很愛說話，總是想聊天。

en: a. (of an animal) not wild or dangerous; trained to live with people; not exciting or interesting; vt. to make a wild animal obedient and gentle; to control or limit something
ex: The tame rabbit ate food from my hand.
那隻溫馴的兔子從我手裡吃東西。

en: n. a large container for holding liquid or gas; a heavy military vehicle with a gun and tracks; vt. to store something in a tank
ex: The fuel tank was almost empty.
油箱幾乎空了。

en: n. a device for controlling the flow of water from a pipe; a light hit or touch; vt. to hit lightly; to use or take something from a source; vi. to hit something lightly
ex: Please turn off the tap when you brush your teeth.
刷牙時請把水龍頭關掉。

en: a. having a good, pleasant taste; (informal) attractive or interesting
ex: The chicken soup was warm and very tasty.
那碗雞湯又熱又好吃。

en: n. a drop of water from the eye; a hole made by pulling something apart; vt. to pull something apart so that it is damaged; vi. to cry; to rush or run quickly
ex: She wiped a tear from her cheek.
她擦去臉頰上的一滴淚。

en: n. a tendency to become angry; a person's usual state of mind; the hardness of a metal; vt. to make something less severe; to heat and cool metal to make it stronger
ex: He has a quick temper and gets angry easily.
他脾氣很急，容易發怒。

en: n. a measure of how hot or cold something is; a body heat that is higher than normal; the degree of heat in a place or substance
ex: The temperature dropped below zero last night.
昨晚氣溫降到零度以下。

en: a. lasting for only a short time; not permanent; n. a worker employed for a short period
ex: He took a temporary job during the summer holiday.
他在暑假期間做了一份短期工作。

en: vi. to be likely to do something or to behave in a certain way; to go in a particular direction; vt. to take care of someone or something
ex: Prices tend to rise at the end of the year.
價格往往在年底上漲。

en: a. (of food) soft and easy to cut or chew; gentle and loving; painful when touched; young and weak; vt. to offer something formally; n. a formal offer to supply goods or services
ex: The steak was cooked until it was tender.
牛排煮到軟嫩。

en: n. a portable shelter made of cloth and held up by poles; a covering over a bed; vi. to camp in a tent
ex: We put up the tent beside the lake.
我們在湖邊搭了帳篷。

en: n. a word or phrase used for a particular thing, especially in a specialized field; a period of time during which something lasts; a division of the school or university year; (plural) conditions of an agreement; vt. to call or name something
ex: The professor explained the meaning of the technical term.
教授解釋了這個專業術語的意思。

en: n. the written words in a book, newspaper or other document; a written message sent from a mobile phone; the main body of a book rather than pictures or notes; vt. to send a text message
ex: She sent me a text to say she was running late.
她傳簡訊給我，說她會遲到。

en: n. a book that teaches a particular subject and is used in schools or universities
ex: The English textbook has many useful exercises.
這本英文教科書有許多實用的練習。
